limitations: Site labels are untrusted native inspector metadata, not MCP rendered names
Only elements admitted by the rendered viewport filter are included
Divider preferences last for the current browser window
earlierAttempts: Initial build failed because the previous disposable preview held the production DLL; closed preview through ordinary-user native messages and rebuilt successfully
Restricted-runner native_ui_tests failed fixture ACL access; ordinary-user rerun passed all three focused native suites
coverage: Production CEF/MCP with disposable profiles, native window/keyboard messages and PrintWindow; no physical input

checks.name: Menu enables a website-side panel using filtered evidence
Native submit controls and editable comboboxes preserve label boundaries
Panel width and list/details divider resize independently with minimum bounds
Selection shows frame, bounds and states without agent action tokens
Selecting a row highlights its current rendered node
Page picker selects the corresponding row without activating it
Canceling the picker restores ordinary selection
Interactable filter removes text and disabled controls
Panel refresh leaves an existing agent observation usable
Tab switching replaces evidence with the selected document
Authentication protection removes diagnostic elements
Disable hides the panel and discards its rows
